findings.title: Concurrent invalidation makes the idle filter throw IllegalStateException, giving a raw 500
Admin sign-in has no throttling, so a LAN client can guess passwords online without limit and use BCrypt to load the CPU
findings.reason: The store spec excludes lockout and rate limiting ("No sign-in lockout", decision OQ-23, NFR-2 LAN only). AdminSessionTest proves 20 failures do not lock.

findings.title: The admin password and the SESSION cookie travel in cleartext on the home LAN (no Secure flag, no TLS)
findings.reason: The store spec excludes TLS ("no public hosting, TLS termination", LAN only, NFR-2). The SESSION cookie cannot be Secure without TLS.

findings.title: The build has no Maven dependency advisory scan, so checklist item 7 cannot be verified
findings.reason: A dependency advisory scan is a harness-wide build concern with no admin-access requirement. It belongs in ../docs/factory as a PD change, not in this slice.

findings.title: tasks.md 5.5 is unticked and current-state.md is stale relative to the commit
A failed sign-in that carries a valid session resets the idle clock, though the spec says a 401 must not reset anything
The sign-in advice takes over HttpMessageNotReadable and HttpMediaTypeNotSupported handling for the whole app at HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE
findings.reason: Every other path delegates to Spring ResponseEntityExceptionHandler.handleException with the same MessageSource, so the responses equal Boot defaults. The global scope is needed because 415 is raised before a handler is chosen.
